within-region seed paired W/T/L using normal 95% CI
BASE_G1 versus deterministic PPO and PURE_G1 under identical coordinate/seed cube

tests: Spearman association between FINAL PDR and paired improvement

regional_transfer_model.inputs: 21 predecision static infrastructure features only; no policy outcome or LB-T feature
regional_transfer_model.continuous_target: FINAL regional PDR - BASE_G1 regional PDR
regional_transfer_model.model: nested province-code GroupKFold standardized Ridge with alpha in [0.1,1,10,100]
regional_transfer_model.high_benefit_summary: depth-2 balanced CART for top-20% paired benefit

mechanism_analysis: associations of candidate execution rates with regional difficulty and improvement; non-causal

explanation_protocol.coordinates: random4 p3 development fold, all 250 districts

explanation_protocol.mode_choice_set: fit only for non-stay helipad destinations when AMB and UAV are both available
explanation_protocol.spatial_validation: district GroupKFold with equal total fit weight per district

multiplicity: Holm adjustment within each named reference family
missing_data: no imputation; analysis requires the complete 250 x 30 x 4 policy grid
selection_rule: no policy, candidate, threshold, horizon, rollout count, or seed changes after blind outcomes are inspected
claim_boundary: generalization is within the Korean hospital database and current simulator assumptions
